SHA-256 sums are shown for the packages this harness downloaded and checked; the others can be verified against the signature zip (deb/rpm: a detached signature over the package, checked by the install script with ServiceNow's certificate) or the embedded signature (msi/pkg).

## Which package for which system

* **Ubuntu, x86_64 (.deb)** - every Ubuntu release (the install script picks this build for Ubuntu 18.04 and later and falls back to it for older ones); it also installs on other Debian-family distributions.

The packages are the same for servers and desktops: one Windows MSI, one rpm, one deb per architecture, one macOS pkg per architecture. Which operating system releases ServiceNow supports is listed in [Server or desktop](README.md#server-or-desktop) on the index page.

## Change log

The Store keeps release notes only for Framework releases still offered for a supported platform family; this version is older than the oldest one listed (4.1.1). Nearest versions with a change log: [4.1.1](4.1.1.md).

## Installing

The instance's own install script (served at `/api/sn_agent/agents/install_agent`, Linux and macOS) downloads the right package for the host, verifies its signature, installs it and writes `acc.yml` with the MID endpoint and API key:

```bash
ACC_VERSION=2.7.0 ACC_API_KEY="<api key>" ACC_MID="wss://<mid host>:8800/ws/events" bash -c "$(curl -L https://<instance>.service-now.com/api/sn_agent/agents/install_agent)"
```

By hand, with the package downloaded from the links above:

```bash
sudo dpkg -i agent-client-collector-2.7.0-ubuntu-1804_amd64.deb      # Debian / Ubuntu (use the ARM64 or Debian file on those systems)
sudo rpm -vi agent-client-collector-2.7.0-x86_64.rpm             # RHEL-family / SUSE
sudo installer -target / -pkg agent-client-collector-2.7.0-macos_arm64.pkg   # macOS (Intel: the macos_x64 file)
```

```powershell
msiexec /i agent-client-collector-2.7.0-windows-x64.msi /qn ACC_API_KEY="<api key>" ACC_MID="wss://<mid host>:8800/ws/events"
```

After a manual Linux or macOS install, set `endpoint` and `api-key` in `acc.yml` (`/etc/servicenow/agent-client-collector/acc.yml`) and restart the `acc` service. The Windows MSI takes both as properties.
